title: PCGExKnowledge search surface
description: The flat search surface across every plugin. Match queries against name, aliases, presets, purpose and situation; fetch full detail from the owning plugin file when kind is entry, or send the reader to url when kind is concept.

id.description: Entry rows: the C++ settings class name, the key into the plugin file's entries map. Concept rows: the documentation path slug.

name.description: Display name as the palette or the page shows it.

category.description: Palette category prefix (Path, Cluster, Filter, ...), when the display name carries one. Entry rows only.

classification.description: node / provider / instanced_factory / factory_data / shared_struct / asset / blueprint_node. Entry rows only; this is the real taxonomy, and only node and provider are placeable in a PCG graph.

aliases.description: Alternative palette names this node is findable under.

presets.description: Preconfigured palette entries of this node.

purpose.description: One flattened sentence: what this is for.

situation.description: The kind of problem that calls for it. Entry rows only.
